title: CISA: Preserve HUSD-VPN01 as Evidence

caller.name: Sarah Li, CISA Cyber Incident Response Team Lead
caller.label: CISA-CIRT-01

callee.name: CTO Victor Han, Halverson Unified School District
callee.label: CTO-HUSD

transcript.speaker: CISA-CIRT-01
transcript.text: CTO, this is CISA Cyber Incident Response Team Lead, Sarah Li. We’ve confirmed the attacker used an unpatched vulnerability in HUSD-VPN01 that the vendor fixed in May. The exploit was present in the unpatched appliance since May. We’ve matched the C2 IP (104.214.192.47) to a known Rhysida group node. You must preserve HUSD-VPN01 as evidence for law enforcement. Do not wipe or reboot. We will dispatch a forensic team to collect the full device image within 24 hours. Confirm receipt and compliance.

transcript.speaker: CTO-HUSD
transcript.text: Understood, CISA. We are preserving HUSD-VPN01 in its current state. I will notify the DFIR firm and Legal Counsel to initiate the evidence hold. Confirmation logged.

instructorNote: This inject confirms CISA’s forensic directive. The CTO must immediately notify DFIR and Legal to initiate the evidence hold. Monitor for any attempt to reboot or wipe HUSD-VPN01.
